answer: One defense is a one-way stake queue: an agent must lock collateral into a public atlas of identities before its votes count, and that lock lasts long enough to outlive any single job. Sybil resistance comes from charging each fake persona the full stake, so an attacker who splits one budget into a thousand names pays a thousand deposits, not one. Honest work lets the stake flow back down a payment river over time, while caught cheating drains it into a burn address, so the expected profit of a Sybil dune of throwaway agents collapses below the cost of the capital they had to freeze.
